{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check if arm and severity are confounded
# Cross-tabulate arm vs severity
tab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df_filtered['arm'], df_filtered['severity'])
print(tab_arm_severity)

# Compute response rates by arm
response_by_arm = df_filtered.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by arm:')
print(response_by_arm)

# Compute difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_response = response_by_arm['treatment']
control_response = response_by_arm['control']
diff = treatment_response - control_response

print(f'\nDifference in proportions (treatment - control): {diff}')"}
